  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)


Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.


Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.


Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

title: Search Engine Marketing Strategist
description:
Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (Search Engine Marketing Strategist) WPP Media Studio – Divisão de E-Commerce

Meio período · Trabalho remoto

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Na WPP Media Studio , acreditamos no poder do marketing digital para gerar conexões reais e duradouras. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e inovação nos permite ajudar marcas globais a alcançar seus objetivos, maximizando o impacto e a relevância no mundo digital.

Com uma visão focada em estratégias de longo prazo e baseadas em dados, somos movidos pelo propósito de oferecer soluções eficazes e resultados consistentes. Nossa missão é criar experiências digitais que transformam marcas e conectam empresas com seus consumidores de maneira significativa.

Agora, para fortalecer nossa equipe de marketing digital, estamos em busca de um Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (SEM) altamente qualificado. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas
  • Gerencia e executa campanhas de Google Ads, Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca , garantindo máxima eficiência
  • Contribui diretamente para a estratégia de e-commerce , gerando resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis
  • Crescimento profissional contínuo : oportunidades para aprimorar suas habilidades e influenciar a estratégia de marketing digital
  • Ambiente colaborativo : uma equipe dinâmica e engajada que trabalha com sinergia para alcançar os melhores resultados
  • Foco no impacto : trabalhamos para gerar valor real para nossos clientes e construir parcerias de longo prazo
  • Cultura missionária : nosso compromisso é sempre com a qualidade, inovação e resultados sustentáveis
  • Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o impacto real que nossos colaboradores fazem na transformação digital de nossos clientes.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails

O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.

A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Sales Analyst


Location: Centro, RJ | Industry: Oil & Gas / Energy


About the Role


We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Sales Analyst to strengthen our Sales team in Brazil. In this role, you will be the backbone of our commercial operations, ensuring smooth execution of sales activities, client requests, and supplier processes. You will work closely with our Sales Director and Managers, bridging commercial, administrative, financial, and logistical tasks to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a professional who enjoys working in a dynamic environment, managing multiple processes, and contributing directly to the success of international sales operations.

What You Will Do


Sales & Back-Office Support

  • Manage client/vendor portals, including quotations, registrations, and contract documentation.
  • Support Sales Managers with key accounts, ensuring accuracy and timely execution of requests.
  • Handle the end-to-end sales cycle for assigned products/services: quotations, importation, resale, tax calculations, and billing.


Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain supplier orders, registrations, and compliance documentation.
  • Control system access, CRM data, and documentation consistency during migrations.


Logistics & Supply Chain

  • Support import/export operations, coordinating suppliers and logistics partners.
  • Maintain strong vendor relationships to secure reliable supply chain solutions.


Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, ensuring clear communication and engagement.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to align expectations and identify opportunities for value creation.
  • Develop strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Map upselling and cross-selling opportunities in collaboration with the Sales team.
  • Provide actionable insights to clients to strengthen their operational efficiency and ROI.
  • Collect structured feedback and translate it into recommendations for internal teams.
  • ork closely with Product, Sales, and Operations to improve solutions and customer experience.
  • Track KPIs and prepare reports on client health, satisfaction, and performance.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial operations, preferably in Oil & Gas, energy, or industrial sectors.
  • Strong expertise in import/export, financial controls, and compliance processes.
  • Advanced skills in Excel and familiarity with CRM systems .
  • Experience with client/vendor portals is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese ; professional proficiency in English .
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and highly organized.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with strong presence in the Oil & Gas and energy sector.
  • Work in a strategic position that connects commercial, financial, and operational processes.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract: 12/01/2025 to 02/28/2026 (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Order Pricing team, responsible for building and enhancing the Pricing applications that define, manage, and apply promotions across the shopping experience. This role focuses on developing high-performance backend systems that ensure accurate, real-time pricing and promotion application to shopping bags.

Consultant will play a key role in designing scalable microservices, implementing event-driven architecture, and driving continuous delivery in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend System Design & Development: Architect, develop, and maintain microservices in Java and Spring Boot to support pricing, promotions setup, and calculation logic.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and maintain asynchronous data flows using Apache Kafka for high throughput and reliability in real-time promotion processing.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment: Build and deploy services on Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, resilience, and observability across environments.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Develop and maintain automated build and deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and Argo CD, ensuring fast, reliable, and secure delivery.
  • Performance & Reliability: Optimize services for high performance and low latency, including caching strategies, database tuning, and message processing efficiency.
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Implement observability and operational monitoring using GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana to ensure system health, proactive alerting, and incident response.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 6–10 years of professional experience in backend software development, preferably within e-commerce, retail, or pricing systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Java 11+ and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
  • Proven experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, topics, schema registry, error handling, and message tracing).
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on Kubernetes.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and ArgoCD
  • Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching (Redis).
  • Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Azure.
  • Experience with GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana for monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
  • Understanding of distributed tracing and log correlation best practices.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are #EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Jira;
  • TeamCity;
  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.

Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

title: City Manager
description:
About the job

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.

  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.

  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Tech Lead | Design System e HTML5
description:
Como Tech Lead com foco em Design System e HTML5 na Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na arquitetura e evolução do framework de front-end da nossa aplicação.


Sua missão será liderar decisões técnicas, definir padrões e garantir a qualidade do nosso Design System, trabalhando lado a lado com UI/UX designers e times de desenvolvimento. Você será a principal referência técnica para o front-end, com forte atuação em mentoria, padronização de código e excelência em experiência do usuário.


Se você tem expertise avançada em React, HTML5, CSS3 e Design System, além de visão estratégica e habilidade para conduzir equipes, essa oportunidade é para você!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar decisões técnicas do framework de front-end da aplicação.
  • Garantir qualidade, padronização e boas práticas no desenvolvimento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com UI/UX designers para manter a coerência visual e fortalecer o Design System.
  • Antecipar problemas técnicos e propor soluções escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Manter documentação técnica e material de onboarding atualizados.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e mentoria da equipe, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento front-end e liderança técnica.
  • Histórico de participação em projetos escaláveis e altamente performáticos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Portfólio técnico relevante (GitHub, projetos, contribuições open source).


Competências Técnicas

  • React (Framework/Library):
  • Domínio completo do React: hooks, context API, lifecycle, components, JSX, BFF (Backend for Frontend), etc.
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado: Redux, Zustand, Recoil, Context, etc.
  • Conhecimento de React Router, Lazy Loading, Code Splitting e SSR (Next.js).
  • Práticas modernas: Componentização, Atomic Design, Design System.
  • Conhecimento sólido de JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript.
  • Experiência com testes: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Robot Framework.
  • HTML5 / CSS3:
  • Domínio das semânticas do HTML5 e práticas de acessibilidade (WCAG, ARIA).
  • Uso avançado de CSS3, incluindo Flexbox, Grid, transições, animações.
  • Experiência com pré-processadores e frameworks: SASS, Tailwind, Styled-Components, Emotion.
  • Complementares:
  • Domínio de uso do framework StencilJs (Diferencial)
  • Aplicação da IA para desenvolvimento, revisão, testes, gestão, etc.
  • Integração com APIs REST e GraphQL.
  • CI/CD, DevOps básico (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Actions).
  • Conhecimento básico de backend (Java, Node.js, Express) é um diferencial.
  • Disposição em trabalhar com tecnologias legadas: Angular, Flash, etc.


Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução do Design System e definir o futuro da experiência front-end da Sankhya, queremos te conhecer!

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.

  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).
