title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: TECH LEAD - TIME DESENVOLVIMENTO, REMOTO
description:

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

As atividades incluem curadoria de influenciadores, cotação de valores, gestão de contratos, briefing de conteúdos e aprovação de conteúdos.

title: Product Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Product Manager Especialista em Cobrança

Principais atividades

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases: concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega de valor para os cooperados por meio da estruturação de histórias de usuário e épicos bem definidos.

Responsável em conduzir o Discovery de produto, analisando a causa raiz das dores dos usuários, levantando hipóteses e validando ideias para garantir que as soluções sejam aderentes às necessidades dos cooperados, direcionando o desenvolvimento do produto para o resultado desejado e ajudando a remover os obstáculos que possam impedir a entrega esperada.

Liderar times ágeis, garantindo entregas eficientes e alinhadas às expectativas dos cooperados.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro, regulatórias e tecnológicas para manter os produtos competitivos.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Organização e priorização de tarefas: Capacidade de levantar e detalhar requisitos, incluindo especificações funcionais para desenvolvimento.


Requisitos desejados

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto/projetos: Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Elaboração e gestão de backlog: saber escrever histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite, priorizar com base em valor de negócio.

Conhecimento em tecnologia: Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto: Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

Conhecimento em produtos financeiros: especialmente relacionados gestão dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamentos (TED/DOC, boletos, carteiras digitais, adquirência, recorrência, split de pagamentos, convênios).

Experiência com frameworks de priorização: Conhecimento em frameworks como RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs. Effort, Kano, entre outros, para auxiliar na priorização de iniciativas.

Conhecimento em Product Discovery: Domínio das etapas de discovery contínuo, entrevistas com usuários, mapeamento de jornada, análise de concorrência e prototipação rápida.


Diferenciais

Experiência como Product Manager ou posição similar em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos como fintechs, bancos ou cooperativas.

Formação em áreas como Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou afins.

Pós-graduação ou MBA com ênfase em Inovação ou Tecnologia, Produto e Gestão Ágil, Negócios e Estratégia ou áreas afins.


Certificações desejáveis:

- CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

- PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner)

- Tera, PM3.

- SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Marketing Coordinator

Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!

Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in.   • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas

  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.

  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Data Modeler
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Modeler will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.

  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
